featured.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
featured.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch introduced xeet, a hermetic, pixel-perfect X post renderer in safe Rust/wasm with zero browser, network, filesystem or system-font dependencies, rendering a post to PNG in ~1ms — 100x–1000x faster than booting a browser for a screenshot. It reproduces Blink & HarfBuzz text shaping, 1/64px line breaking, RTL bidi, 28 Chirp font subsets, CJK/Math/Emoji fallbacks and "Show more" rules. The interesting part is the method: xeet is an "autorepo" — an oracle boots Chrome to verify tens of thous…
featured.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 发布了开源项目 xeet：一个用安全 Rust / wasm 写的、像素级精确的 X 帖子渲染器，不依赖浏览器、网络、文件系统或系统字体，约 1ms 就能把一条帖子渲染成 PNG，比启动浏览器截图快 100–1000 倍。它复刻了 Blink 与 HarfBuzz 的文字排版、1/64px 断行、RTL 双向文本、28 个 Chirp 字体子集以及 CJK/数学/Emoji 回退和“Show more”规则。更值得关注的是工程方法：xeet 是一个“autorepo”——由一个启动 Chrome 的 oracle 验证数万条排版规则，CI canary 持续监控原版变化并为 agent 提交签名 PR，整个项目围绕“验证工程（verification engineering）”构建，Rauch 认为这类工作对人类工程师而言几乎不可能完成。另一条里他顺带调侃：AI 给他写的系统卡顿诊断 CLI 起名叫 hog 🐖，“命名”这一计算机科学难题似乎也被 AI 解决了。

featured.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
featured.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper says the team has been working on "compounding skills" — skills that get better every time you use them — and thinks @hammer_mt finally cracked it. This weekend he built a skill for writing context-window summaries and used autoresearch to iterate until it hit 80% of his taste versus a no-skill baseline. The full writeup is on Every's frontier feed, formatted for agents.
featured.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 表示团队最近在做“复利型技能”（compounding skills，即每次使用都会变得更好的 agent skill），并认为 @hammer_mt 终于把它做通了。他本周末做了一个帮团队撰写上下文窗口摘要的 skill，用 autoresearch 反复迭代，直到在摘要质量上相对无 skill 基线达到他本人品味的 80%。完整方法论已发布在 Every 的 frontier feed 上，供 agent 直接读取。

featured.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev：代币化、Agent 交易与 Harmonic
featured.summaryEn: Vlad Tenev frames Robinhood as "the ownership company" — using tokenization, publicly traded venture funds, prediction markets and agentic trading to put institutional-grade financial capabilities and early-stage ownership into ordinary people's hands — while arguing AI-driven math and science should not be centralized inside a few AI labs. Agentic trading has clear product-market fit: over 150,000 customers opened agentic trading accounts within months of the Robinhood MCP launch, with tool calls growing on a smooth exponential to roughly 30M per day. The newly announced Robinhood Agents puts the harness and UI inside the Robinhood account — "like Claude Code or Codex, optimized for trading" — with daily strategy loops, rebalancing, skills and an agent app store (e.g., satellite data to count cars in retailer parking lots). Safeguards include segregated sandboxed accounts and trade app…

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程与访谈创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang shared clips from his interview with Anthropic designer Nate Parrott. First: Claude designs from a fresh context and thinks it's inventing a brilliant style, so it keeps producing serif text, off-white backgrounds, orange and bars on card edges — in its mind it's only done this once. The Claude Design prompt explicitly tells the model it over-biases toward those fonts and colors and not to use them unless asked, which helps a lot. Second: at The Browser Company, building each Arc idea took weeks; at Ant…
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 发布了对 Anthropic 设计师 Nate Parrott 的访谈片段，有两个实用观点。第一，Claude 生成界面时总在“全新上下文”里，以为自己在发明最出彩的视觉风格，结果总是衬线字体、米白背景、橙色和卡片边条——因为在它看来这是第一次做，所以觉得很原创；Claude Design 的 prompt 里会直接告诉模型“你倾向于过度使用这两种字体和颜色，除非用户要求否则别用”，效果明显。第二，Nate 曾在 The Browser Company 做 Arc，当时每个想法要几周才能做出来验证，在 Anthropic 已压缩到一两天；但被压缩的只是“构建”环节，“把东西交到用户手里、理解他们是否会用”的周期并没有缩短。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux, who works on Codex & ChatGPT at OpenAI, said the Codex team may have actually fixed the "model at capacity" errors that have been pestering users.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 表示，Codex 团队可能已经修复了长期困扰用户的“model at capacity”（模型容量已满）报错。

items.title: Nan Yu · OpenAI Codex 产品（前 Linear 产品负责人）
items.summaryEn: Nan Yu (product on Codex at OpenAI, formerly head of product at Linear) asked for the best home automation hub if he just wants Codex to control everything — ideally something plug-and-play that Codex sees as just another computer.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 产品、前 Linear 产品负责人 Nan Yu 在征集最适合用 Codex 控制全屋的智能家居中枢：希望是即插即用、让 Codex 把它当成“另一台电脑”来操作的设备——一个把编码 agent 延伸到物理世界控制的使用场景。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari announced the next guest in his weekly series: @kanavg1, cofounder of Core Automation, on Friday Nov 20 at noon in SF, discussing all things RL (methods, synthetic data, loops, automation). Format: 60-minute IRL-only, off-the-record sessions under Chatham House rules — 45 minutes of questions for the guest, 15 minutes of the guest asking about venture — open to 15 listeners.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 的每周线下系列活动下一期嘉宾是 Core Automation 联合创始人 @kanavg1，时间 11 月 20 日（周五）中午，地点旧金山，主题是强化学习（方法、合成数据、训练循环、自动化等）。形式为 60 分钟、仅限线下、Chatham House 规则不对外记录，前 45 分钟由 Nikunj 提问，后 15 分钟嘉宾反问风投话题，限 15 位听众。
